title: SNAP maximum allotments - FY 2026
facts: For FY 2026, the maximum monthly SNAP allotment for a 1-person household in the 48 contiguous states and D.C. is $298.
For a 4-person household in the 48 contiguous states and D.C., the maximum monthly allotment is $994.
Actual benefits depend on household circumstances and the SNAP benefit formula; the maximum is not an automatic payment.
Alaska, Hawaii, Guam and the U.S. Virgin Islands have different maximum allotments.
